title: Owner decides the first solution order
goal: Owner decides the first solution order
acceptance: The owner's order, or 'keep it', is given
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Component repositories are read, never written.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24: reading 18 references with their live states and replying with changes, about 15 minutes. Not a measurement.
